biological_objective: Move from donor disease classification to a donor-aware cell-state/regulatory description with uncertainty, within the excitatory lineage.

future_estimand.question: Within author-defined excitatory-lineage cell types, does complete trisomy 21 associate with a prespecified RORB/FOXP1 and TLE4 subtype maturation/regulatory program at the donor level, in RNA expression and in matched ATAC accessibility, after exact developmental age adjustment?
future_estimand.aggregation: per donor and author_cell_type stratum, aggregate the program score across that donor's cells (pseudobulk RNA module and mean ATAC accessibility at program loci); fit a donor-level linear model of program score on DS status with exact dev_PCW as a covariate
future_estimand.primary_contrast: donor-level DS-minus-control program-score difference within each prespecified excitatory-lineage stratum, pooled with donor-cluster bootstrap uncertainty
future_estimand.age_handling: dev_PCW is donor-invariant (observed 10-20, no donor with two values) and is entered as an exact covariate; no silent age binning
future_estimand.batch_handling: batch_seq and library are NOT donor-invariant in 7 of 30 donors (two sequencing batches/libraries per donor). Aggregate within donor and report the 7 mixed-batch donors as a prespecified sensitivity; do not treat batch as a donor-level covariate
future_estimand.required_atac_coverage: measured ATAC intervals overlapping the gene bodies/promoters of the same prespecified program genes
future_estimand.falsification_criterion: The maturation-program hypothesis is not supported if the donor-level DS-minus-control program contrast 95% donor-bootstrap interval includes zero after exact dev_PCW adjustment, or if the contrast is explained by a shift in author cell-type composition (e.g. reduced NEU_RORB proportion) rather than within-subtype program change.
future_estimand.source_defined_hypothesis: Lattke et al. 2026 Nat Med (this development cohort; not independent) reports a subtype-specific reduction of RORB/FOXP1-expressing (NEU_RORB) and TLE4-expressing (NEU_TLE4) excitatory neurons and a scMEGA excitatory-lineage regulatory network including FEZF2, FOXP1, RORA, TCF7L2 and Chr21 TFs BACH1/PKNOX1/GABPA.

support_audit.rna_feature_coverage: SUPPORTED: all 13 prespecified program genes are present in the raw/var gene axis
support_audit.atac_feature_coverage: NOT_SUPPORTED by the current measured panels: 1 of 13 program genes (TLE4) has any overlapping measured region (chr9:79571205-79572111), and it is shared by both the 480-region historical and 465-region tie-break panels; RORB and FOXP1 have none
support_audit.interpretation: The historical and tie-break region panels were selected by training-library prevalence without regard to this program, so they are not a targeted regulatory panel for the maturation hypothesis. A within-lineage ATAC program question requires a locus-targeted region set or the author peak-by-cell matrix / a bounded fragment recount on gene-proximal windows; that acquisition is outside this assignment.
support_audit.annotation_note: author_cell_type labels are descriptive context, not independent truth; they are not to be treated as ground-truth classes for a new classifier.

annotation_support.note: Motivates the hypothesis and supplies annotations but analyzes the same development cohort; cannot be independent validation or a novelty claim.

orthogonal_assay_support.missing: no independent orthogonal ATAC/accessibility assay or author QC replay has been acquired

independent_cohort_replication.rna_only_candidate: GSE280175 (10 snRNA samples, 5 DS / 5 control, PCW 13-19) could test the RNA program direction only; it cannot validate ATAC or paired routing.
independent_cohort_replication.paired_candidate: NeMO Vuong et al. (DOI 10.1126/science.aea1259; parent nemo:col-umstjg0; RNA nemo:col-mbgxwtz; ATAC nemo:col-ad8t52b) remains the reserved paired external candidate with unresolved per-file declaration, QC/barcode stage and compatible measured-region gates.
independent_cohort_replication.missing_action: obtain a versioned author retained-barcode/QC rule and an exact measured-interval contract; resolve the ATAC manifest Access field; then a bounded recount can be scoped

claim_boundaries: This is a proposed future estimand. No model was fitted and no disease effect was estimated.
Author cell-type annotations are descriptive context, not independent truth.
The RNA program is testable now; the ATAC program is not supported by the current measured panels.
No novel mechanism, disease claim, or independent validation is asserted.
